lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: The reaffirmed FY2026 guide needs a sharp H2 ramp. On revenue, $1.4bn less H1 $673m ($308m Q1 + $365m Q2) leaves $727m for H2. On adj. EBITDA, $294m less H1 $117.4m leaves $176.6m, against Q2's $76.9m. With Q3 volume down q/q and fixed costs guided up low single digits in Q3 and Q4, Q4 would need about $370m+ revenue and about $95m EBITDA. That makes a trim, or a guide hit only through an aggressive Q4, likely. The macro moved against the guide: the Fed hiked 25bp on 2026-09-16 (its first hike since 2023) and 12 of 18 officials project another by year-end. A direct peer, Pagaya, implied a Q4 volume midpoint about 14% below Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide-driven prints have produced this name's largest moves: Feb 2025 +31.8% on a strong initial guide; Aug 2025 -18.7% and Feb 2026 -15.0% on guide/take-rate disappointment (baseline). A reaffirm in Aug 2026 got -0.4% and then about -30% drift.

findings.finding: Per-day originations accelerated through the quarter rather than fading: July $51.0m/day, August $50.7m/day, September $53.1m/day, the best of Q3 even though September included the post-hike weeks. findings.finding: Apple's December-quarter iPhone guide faces a $85.3B (+23%) comp with no base iPhone 18 this fall. Nikkei (2026-10-09) reported October iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max component orders cut 15-20% from Apple's original requests on soft demand; Securities Times says Pro Max +10-15% and Pro -10-15%, total flat. Counterpoint's first-three-weeks sell-through for the 18 Pro series is +3.1% globally (US -4%, Japan -27%, China +29%). Consensus December revenue of ~$152B (+5.7%) needs iPhone roughly flat to up on that comp.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide is the line Apple trades on. July 2026: guide of 9-11% against ~12% expected, -7.3% next close (apexvol) after a beat. April 2026: guide of 14-17% above estimates, +3.2%.

findings.finding: iPhone Duo ($1,999, on sale 10-23) is supply-limited. BofA puts average delivery waits at 79 days, with shipments into January. Apple said on ~10-26/27 it will replace Duo units with inner-display cracks, and reports say replacement stock is drawing on already depleted inventory. So less Duo revenue lands in the December quarter than Counterpoint's ~6M-units-this-year figure implies.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Supply-constraint commentary in the July 2026 guide was cited as a cause of the -7.3% move. Apple has historically guided through iPhone supply constraints (January 2026: 'currently constrained').

findings.finding: Memory costs are still rising into the December quarter. SK hynix's Q3 2026 DRAM ASP was up high-20s % QoQ and it sees shortages through 2030. TrendForce sees Q4 conventional DRAM contracts +10-15% and Q3 mobile DRAM +8-13% QoQ, though it expects Q4 mobile increases to narrow. Apple said in July it expects 'to pay even higher memory costs', and its own Sept-quarter GM guide is ~46-47% ex-refunds. The December GM guide risks landing below Goldman's 46.8%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July 2026 sell-off was attributed to memory costs plus the guide (https://www.euronews.com/business/2026/07/31/apple-shares-fall-despite-record-revenue-as-outlook-disappoints).

findings.finding: Third-party trackers put calendar Q3 2026 iPhone units at 56.5M, flat YoY (Omdia, 2026-10-29), or -4% (IDC), against Apple's guide of mid-teens iPhone revenue growth (consensus $56.54B, +15%). Omdia says channel partners stocked up ahead of expected price increases, and the 18 Pro/Pro Max carry +$100 list prices, so the guide holds only on ASP and channel fill.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Apple's reported-quarter beats have been sold or ignored. EPS beat in each of the last six to eight quarters while three of the last six reactions were negative (investing.com preview).

findings.finding: App Store trend into the Sept quarter is soft. UBS/Sensor Tower: June-quarter App Store +3% reported (US -6%). Sensor Tower via FT: US commission revenue down 18% since the start of 2026. Services consensus already assumes +10% ($31.56B), the slowest in more than three years.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved instance found of this name moving on a Services-only miss. Services decelerations have been folded into guide reactions.

findings.finding: Mac shipments in calendar Q3 2026 fell 11.3% YoY to 5.9M (IDC). Omdia and Counterpoint also show ~-11%. Apple raised Mac prices in late June, and the July guide flagged supply constraints on Mac.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Mac (~9% of revenue) has not moved this stock alone in the resolved record found.

findings.finding: TSMC's Q3 2026 smartphone revenue rose 10% QoQ to 21% of sales, and its Q4 guide of $52.3-54.3B came in above the ~$49.1B expected. The upstream supplier of Apple's A-series/M-series silicon is building into Apple's December quarter, not cutting.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None specific; supplier read-throughs have not been a measured driver for this name.

findings.finding: The Q4 guide is the line that decided this name's reactions. In Nov 2025 Hinge guided Q4 to $155-157M, flat on a $154.2M Q3 (Q4 later printed $170.7M), and the stock fell 15.06% on an 8.6% beat. The current FY guide implies a Q4'26 of about $239M, flat-to-down on a Q3 likely printing $237-245M. Unless FY is raised by more than the Q3 beat plus the $7-8M Cylinder contribution, the implied Q4 will look like a sequential stall against a stock priced for acceleration.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A conservative, flat-sequential Q4 guide in Nov 2025 was followed by -15.06%. The strong initial FY guide in Feb 2026 bought +17.28%. A $34-38M FY raise in Aug 2026 bought only +1.73%.
